originality.rationale: The complete statement gives a characteristic-3 two-divisor Newton stratification of a natural symmetric disjoint-elliptic Howe subfamily and exact rational-parameter counts for every 3-power. The closest inspected primary theorems address genus-five Howe sextic models and their singularities, large-characteristic Serre-bound constructions, or large-characteristic superspecial existence, not these parameters or arithmetic strata. Prior genus-three calculations cover different branch families and at most a restricted slice. A general quotient isogeny does not by itself imply the explicit rank divisors or counts. Searches are not a uniqueness proof; unindexed arithmetic overlap remains possible.
residual_risks: The same rank-locus calculation might appear in an unindexed older arithmetic treatment of even quartic fiber products or in work not searchable by coefficient aliases.

This classification applies only to the specified coordinate-marked symmetric subfamily, and must not be misread as a novel general Klein-four decomposition or classification of all genus-five curves.
The constant supersingular quotient makes generic nonordinarity expected; the substantive addition is the complete transverse-strata structure and extension-degree-dependent census.

value.rationale: A concrete moduli/arithmetic problem motivated by the genus-five disjoint-elliptic Howe construction: fix the supersingular elliptic branch cover and the common base involution, then identify the entire 3-rank and Newton stratification of the remaining two-dimensional symmetric family. The rank-three locus is a reduced normal-crossings pair of Hasse divisors and its unique intersection forces the rank-two polygon; the exact marked parameter census for every extension of F3 exhibits a genuine parity-dependent discriminant-boundary effect. This is a natural complete classification of a motivated family, rather than a one-off normalization check or arbitrary sample. Scope remains the marked two-parameter family, without claims about full genus-five moduli or downstream consequences.
